card.title: I Can Handle This
card.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm completely prepared for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My approach exactly. Leave the jug; I prefer a thorough preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I always arrange a reader. Start gently; that's part of my system.

mechanism: A performs emotional preparedness while appropriating B's offered water and reading help as parts of A's system.
confusable: Unlike honest acceptance of support, A must present the borrowed methods as already intended.
comparison: D114-b claims habitual arranged readers; D114-a claims advance support-network planning after hearing B's method.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
